decision.top3_why: The weighted strategy w1 (gradient‑boosted weights trained on other series) achieves the best validation score and shows the most stable per‑window performance (0.69, 0.55, 0.63) compared to the mean and inverse‑error weighted alternatives. Given the diagnosis of unstable rankings and correlated errors, a robust weighted combination that adapts to model strengths is preferable.
decision.top3_why_not: B (plain mean) is less robust to unstable rankings and performs worse on the second window.
